reasoning_content:
The user wants me to:

1. Reactivate the .bak files by renaming them back to .ts
2. Check ESM compliance - fix any require/module.exports
3. Fix runtime crashes in WorldTick systems
4. Fix bug-fixing logic in DeveloperAgent/ReviewerAgent
5. Ignore Jules files, use pnpm

Let me start by finding and renaming the .bak files.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

print("=== 1. REACTIVATING .bak FILES ===")

# Find all .bak files related to our targets
files_to_restore = [
    "LegendPropagationSystem.ts.bak",
    "tick-generator.ts.bak", 
    "HazardResonance.ts.bak",
    "DeveloperAgent.ts.bak",
    "ReviewerAgent.ts.bak"
]

for f in files_to_restore:
    stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(f"find /opt/areloria/server/src -name '{f}' 2>/dev/null")
    result = stdout.read().decode().strip()
    if result:
        # Rename back
        new_name = result.replace('.bak', '')
        stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command(f"mv {result} {new_name} 2>&1")
        print(f"Restored: {new_name}")
    else:
        print(f"Not found: {f}")

# Verify
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("find /opt/areloria/server/src -name '*.bak' | head -10")
print("\nRemaining .bak files:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
